title: Secret of Mana - Where the Wind Ends (Lofty Mountains)
description:
Will fit sky-like or misty mountain levels. Alternatives are ice-like and forest settings, or overworlds.
This is the song that plays in Lofty Mountains, just before entering the 6th elemental palace in Secret of Mana.
